label: nova-mock-session
note: Full 5-phase NOVA athletic workout session verification: screening, dynamic warm-up, 5-round HIIT circuit with interval timers, recovery cooldown, and final summary.

events.text:
Hey Athlete! Welcome to your NOVA session.

Today: HIIT Circuit, Strength and Conditioning. Before we begin, how are you feeling on a scale of 1 to 5?

Got it - energy calibrated. High energy locked in. Let us make this count.

Next: Warm-Up Protocol. Three minutes of dynamic activation. Hit Start on the timer and work through each movement.

Warm-up complete! Body is primed. Entering the Main Circuit (Phase 3).

5 rounds, 4 exercises, 40 seconds each. Start the timer and push!

Round 1 complete! Halfway there. You are doing great.

Starting Round 2. Reset the timer and go!

Round 2 complete! Past the midpoint. This is where champions are made.

Starting Round 3. Reset the timer and go!
Entering Cooldown and Recovery (Phase 4). Let your heart rate come down.
Session complete. Outstanding work Athlete. Here is your summary (Phase 5).

state.ui_state: root = Screens([welcome, warmup, circuit, cooldown, summary], summary)
